comment: The real-program checks that run-hidden.ps1 runs as a gate. Each takes the window program, the stand-in agent and a fresh output folder, and uses only the isolated home of lib/hidden-desktop.cjs. leftOut gives every other *-hidden.cjs file with the reason it is not in the gate, so a new check is either run or accounted for.

leftOut.answer-origin-hidden: Starts the program with the caller's whole environment, so it is not isolated from the profile of whoever runs it.
leftOut.attention-hidden: Needs the full playwright package, which the suites do not install, and the caller's whole environment.
leftOut.broadcast-all-hidden: Needs the full playwright package, which the suites do not install, and the caller's whole environment.
leftOut.first-restart-hidden: Needs two older builds, a bus fixture built from old source, and a Playwright found at a fixed path in another repository.
leftOut.going-back-hidden: Needs an old build and the invented state that scripts/going-back-trial.ps1 prepares.
leftOut.org-chart-hidden: Needs a seed home and a refusing provider program that its own harness builds.
leftOut.profile-version-hidden: Needs two builds with different versions and an asset manifest from scripts/profile-version-trial.ps1.
leftOut.release-dinah-hidden: Needs a folder of release binaries and a Playwright found at a fixed path in another repository.
leftOut.restart-copy-hidden: Runs on a prepared copy of a real database, which no hosted runner has.
leftOut.restart-hidden: Needs the full playwright package, which the suites do not install.
leftOut.set-aside-live-hidden: Needs a holder program that its own harness builds.
